comment:
No production defect confirmed in the scoped review of `201740a0da35`.

**Verified:** the helper matches desktop entries by name, id or startup class, including case folding and the spaced-name retry. The notification suite passes all 143 assertions. Source inspection preserves this priority:

```text
notification image
  otherwise: resolvable sender app_icon
  otherwise: matching desktop entry's icon  [new]
  no match: existing blank/glyph behavior
```

**Optional test improvement:** removing either startup-class matching or the hyphenated retry still leaves all 143 assertions passing. The Chrome fixture already matches its display name, and no assertion needs `startupClass`. Give the Chrome entry a different display name and add a class-only match, so those two regressions become detectable. These are test-coverage gaps, not failures of the current helper.

**Documentation correction:** consider removing or correcting the new libnotify sentence in `NotificationLogic.js`: [upstream release notes](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libnotify/-/blob/0.8.6/NEWS) describe an image-hint change in 0.8.4, reverted to `app_icon` in 0.8.5/0.8.6, not a move to `desktop-entry`.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** isolated JavaScript tests with synthetic desktop entries and diagnostic mutations; QML precedence and API checked by source/type metadata. No live notification, visual rendering or theme-resolution verification. Empty or unmatched app names remain outside the new fallback.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** GPT 6 Astra Medium initial inspection and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, followed by verification against targeted test and source evidence.
